title: Rules-engine event
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0, which is the WORKING TREE and is not committed. The nearest commit is b62b25e, which is a different firmware version - do not read x-commit as containing this behaviour. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: D2C telemetry. `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

schema.description: Wire-contract identifier. Constant; bump signals a breaking payload change. Range/enum: Fixed literal "eflostop.v2".

ts.description: Device wall-clock at message BUILD time. The whole message is destroyed (never sent, never buffered) if ts < 1704067200, so a pre-SNTP leak event is lost permanently. Units: seconds (Unix epoch, UTC). Range/enum: >= 1704067200 (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

id.description: Immutable hub id derived from the WiFi STA MAC in eFuse. Same string used as the DPS registration id and the MQTT client id. Range/enum: "GW-" + 12 uppercase hex.

short_id.description: Last 2 bytes of the STA MAC as 4 hex chars. Also the SoftAP SSID suffix (WiFi-Hub-XXXX) the installer matches during setup. Range/enum: 4 uppercase hex chars.

name.description: User-assigned hub name from twin desired hub_name or C2D set_hub_name. NOTE the opposite convention on the twin plane, where hub_name is always emitted as "". Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars (HUB_NAME_MAX_LEN). Presence: conditional: OMITTED when the stored name is empty.

fw.description: Hub firmware version, read at runtime from the ESP-IDF app descriptor (PROJECT_VER). Never a hardcoded string. Range/enum: "1.8.0" in the working tree (CMakeLists.txt:12); "0.0.0" if the descriptor is empty.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since boot from the monotonic esp_timer. On an offline-buffer replay this is the ORIGINAL build-time value, possibly from a previous boot. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0.

type.description: Envelope discriminator. Tells the backend which `data` shape to expect. Range/enum: enum: "lifecycle" | "snapshot" | "event".

event.description: Event discriminator inside data. The single most important routing key for the backend event log. Range/enum: enum, 18 values: online | valve_state_changed | valve_flood_detected | valve_flood_cleared | leak_detected | leak_cleared | cmd_ack | auto_close | auto_close_blocked_override | auto_close_reenabled | rmleak_cleared | rmleak_auto_cleared | water_access_override_enabled | water_access_override_expired | device_offline | device_recovered | rules_engine | health_engine. Presence: always in lifecycle and in every event shape; ABSENT in snapshot.

source_type.description: Which transport/peer class the leak came from. "reconnect" is a pseudo-source used only by the valve-reconnect auto_close. Range/enum: enum: lora | ble_leak_sensor | valve_flood | reconnect | unknown. Presence: always in leak events and in the auto_close / auto_close_blocked_override rules events.
source_type.x-source: main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:642 (leak events, "lora" | "ble_leak_sensor" from main/iothub/app_iothub.c:1749, :1809); main/rules_engine/rules_engine.c:334, :470 via source_to_str main/rules_engine/rules_engine.c:259-267; reconnect variant main/rules_engine/rules_engine.c:935

sensor_id.description: Identifies the sensor. LoRa uses 0x+8hex, BLE uses a colon MAC, the valve's own flood sensor uses the literal "valve", and an unresolved id becomes "unknown". Range/enum: "0x"+8hex | colon MAC | "valve" | "unknown". Presence: always in leak events, auto_close, auto_close_blocked_override and health alerts.

rmleak_asserted.description: Confirms the hub asserted the valve's RMLEAK interlock as part of the auto-close. Hardcoded true at both sites. Range/enum: always true when present. Presence: always (auto_close events only).

code.description: Machine-readable room code. Range/enum: enum, 13 values: unknown | bathroom | kitchen | laundry | garage | garden | basement | utility | hallway | bedroom | living_room | attic | outdoor. Presence: present whenever data.location is present.

label.description: User-entered free-text location label. Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars. Presence: present whenever data.location is present.

location.description: Installed-location metadata for the sensor that raised the event. TWO DIFFERENT ABSENCE CONVENTIONS on the same path depending on the producer. Presence: leak events: ALWAYS. auto_close: OMITTED when the source is valve_flood or no metadata is stored..

active_leak_count.description: How many sensors were simultaneously asserting a leak. Present ONLY in these two shapes, so the normal auto_close lacks it. Units: count. Range/enum: >= 0. Presence: always in the valve-reconnect auto_close and in water_access_override_expired.

override_remaining_s.description: Seconds left in the override window. Reports the FULL window duration when the clock is unsynced, and 0 when expired but not yet processed by the rules tick. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0 when present. Presence: snapshot: OMITTED unless override_active AND remaining >= 0. auto_close_blocked_override event: OMITTED when remaining < 0..

trigger.description: What opened the override window: a physical long-press on the valve, or the override_enable C2D command. Range/enum: enum: button | c2d_command. Presence: always (water_access_override_enabled only).

expires_ts.description: Absolute epoch at which the override window expires. Same field name and meaning on both message types. Units: seconds (Unix epoch, UTC). Range/enum: >= 1704067200. Presence: snapshot: OMITTED unless override_active AND the expiry is known/in-future. water_access_override_enabled event: always..

remaining_s.description: Full override window duration at the moment the window was started or refreshed. A CONSTANT, not a countdown; the countdown is override_remaining_s. Units: seconds. Range/enum: 86400 in a production build (compile-overridable via -D OVERRIDE_WINDOW_DURATION_S). Presence: always (water_access_override_enabled only).

override_cancelled.description: A leak_reset also tore down an open override window. Range/enum: always true when present. Presence: conditional: OMITTED when no override window was open.

previous_remaining_s.description: How much of the override window was discarded when it was cancelled early. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0. Presence: always (auto_close_reenabled only).
previous_remaining_s.x-source: main/rules_engine/rules_engine.c:721; value returned by cancel_override_window() at :715

reason.description: TWO DISTINCT MEANINGS ON ONE PATH. In a snapshot it is the trigger that caused the snapshot. In the auto_close_reenabled rules event it is the cause of the override cancellation. Range/enum: enum, 7 values total. snapshot: heartbeat | event | commission | boot | fast | decommission. rules event: c2d_command. Presence: snapshot: always in practice; rules event: always.
reason.x-source: snapshot main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:383 with main/iothub/app_iothub.c:581-591 and :1570; rules event main/rules_engine/rules_engine.c:722

auto_close_resumed.description: Whether leaks were still active when the window expired, i.e. whether auto-close fired immediately on resume. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: always (water_access_override_expired only).

clear_after_seconds.description: The all-clear dwell time that had to elapse before the hub auto-cleared the RMLEAK interlock. Units: seconds. Range/enum: AUTO_CLEAR_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000. Presence: always (rmleak_auto_cleared only).

raw.description: Verbatim rules-/health-engine JSON string, emitted only when re-parsing that string fails. The string was itself produced by cJSON_PrintUnformatted, so this is reachable only on allocation failure. Presence: conditional: OMITTED unless cJSON_Parse of the engine JSON fails.

data.description: Type-specific payload container. Created and attached with UNCHECKED cJSON calls in every publisher, so an allocation failure yields a published envelope with NO data key. Presence: always in practice; see note.
